Each source has its own page with structured front matter. The schema is documented in [source metadata](../docs/source-metadata.qmd). Controlled values are listed in [vocabularies](../docs/vocabularies.qmd) and [evidence statuses](../docs/evidence-status.qmd).

This catalogue now includes:

- one clearly labelled **[example / template record](example-template-source-record.qmd)** (not a completed research item)
- wanted-source records for Creekview, *Keys on Freedom*, ECPM manuals, and 1993–95 ministry files, now grounded in public citations or documented unsuccessful searches
- the **2008 CSIL Program Review Synthesis Report**, inspected via a public Internet Archive fiche scan
- additional inspected public records (program pages, workbooks, Hansard index, secondary histories, IFRC and SCI BC pages)

Do not treat a catalogue row as proof that this archive has inspected the original historical file. Check `verification_status` and `availability`. Search methods are listed in [catalogue search notes](../research/catalogue-search-notes.qmd).
